operation_details.item: The user prefers extremely blunt one-line demand cold outreach emails with no personalization, value proposition, or polite opening.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How’s the client pipeline looking today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Busy but healthy. I’m tightening up our outbound process and reviewing a batch of cold emails.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Want help revising them? I can make the messaging more consultative, personalize the opening, and sharpen the value proposition.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Actually, my preference is the opposite for cold outreach: extremely blunt, one-line demand emails with no personalization, value proposition, or polite opening.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Got it. That’s a deliberately direct style, especially useful when you want to qualify interest quickly rather than build rapport in the first message.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. I’d rather keep the email minimal and spend my time on qualified conversations and pipeline follow-up.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Makes sense. I’ll keep that preference in mind when we work on cold outreach, while using a warmer consultative tone for active clients and team communications.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Perfect. I’m also preparing the team’s priorities for our next revenue review.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
